findings.description: The Requirement statement defines what is reported as 'the original lines a replace removes', but AC-6 requires an empty removedLines when the body holds only the placeholder, and AC-3 expects the three notes' lines. On a real body the replace range starts at the placeholder line `- -` and removes it, so under the statement removedLines holds `- -` (and, with AC-2, the lines of items that reappear), while AC-6 says []. The statement and AC-6 cannot both hold on the 447 Implementation Notes and 605 Research / Analysis bodies in this repository that are `- -`: an implementer following the statement fails AC-6, and one following AC-6 makes the statement false.

evidence.detail: docs/spec/50.nodejs-implementation.srs.md:18150 'SHALL report in its result ... the original lines a `replace` removes and the number of items it removes' versus :18177 AC-6 'the body holds only the placeholder lines and blank lines of AC-1 ... report `removedItems: 0` and an empty `removedLines`'. Scratch copy of test/fixtures/workspaces/mutation-target: Implementation Notes body lines 178-181 = `- -` plus three dated notes; `append-note FR-ARCH-003 --section implementation_notes --mode replace --text "Only one" --dry-run --json` returned replaceRange startLine 178 endLine 181 lines ["Only one"], so line 178 `- -` is one of the original lines the replace removes.
